Description:
Asaram Bapu was once seen as a powerful spiritual leader, but his name is now synonymous with controversy and crime. In this video, we dive into two major cases that shook the nation—the mysterious deaths of two boys in his ashram in 2008 and the shocking assault case of 2013 that led to his arrest.
We also uncover how law enforcement faced resistance not just from his devoted followers but also from influential figures in politics and bureaucracy.
